content.value: A cloud service provider monitors server response time (in ms) during peak hours. A (15) [CO2] sample of the recorded data is as follows:
i) Explain how a Q-Q plot would be used to assess whether the data follows a normal distribution.
ii) Identify whether the dataset indicates skewness or heavy tails.
iii) Discuss how such behavior affects system reliability.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2024
